messages:
Marie (Sales): Hey team — Customer asked for explicit key-ceremony windows and pricing for HSM-attested BYO-KMS during the POC. They want: 1) a dry-run key ceremony, 2) production cutover window, 3) audit log retention SLA. Can we confirm what we can commit in the SOW?
Alex (Solutions Eng): Quick Q — are they expecting us to host the escrow or perform an hsm-to-hsm wrap?
Customer IT: We prefer HSM-to-HSM wrap, pulled into our Azure Key Vault. Need to know if Redwood will accept a wrapped key import or if we must re-generate inside our HSM.
Jordan (Security Eng): We can support two modes: 
- import-wrapped-key (we never persist unwrapped key material)
- remote-key-proxy (requests sign/unwrap inside customer HSM via KMIP or custom connector)
Both need contractual language about key custody and an ATO checklist.
Alex (Solutions Eng): For the POC dry-run we can do: 
1) test handshake endpoint and CA-signed certs
2) import a wrapped key and verify token issuance
3) run a simulated rotation (generate new key, wrap, swap)
Here's a minimal example of our test config we send to customers:```yaml
redwood_private:
  kms:
    provider: external
    endpoint: https://kms.handshake.customer.example
    auth: mTLS
    key_id: projects/customer/keys/rw-main
```
Priya (Acct Exec): Pricing notes: reserved HSM hours billed monthly (commit SKU) + one-time POC setup fee. If we do an on-site key ceremony we'll add travel/time. For HSM-attested import we include an integration fee — typically a one-time $10-25k range depending on vendor work. I'll draft a range for legal to review.
Customer IT: Audit logs: we need 7 years retention for key events and evidence for rotation. Can you ship audit events to our SIEM (syslog/HTTPS)? Also want proof of key lineage for compliance.
Jordan (Security Eng): We can stream KMS/audit events to customer syslog or an S3 endpoint with signed objects. Retention in-platform is configurable (30/90/365 days) by default; 7 years would require exporting to their archive (we can automate exports to their S3/GCS/Azure) and sign them. Must add to the SOW.
Alex (Solutions Eng): For the handshake validation test the customer can run:```bash
# test TLS + mTLS handshake to our endpoint
openssl s_client -connect kms.handshake.customer.example:443 -cert client.crt -key client.key -CAfile ca.crt
# minimal import call (example)
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key -X POST https://kms.handshake.customer.example/v1/import -d '{"wrapped_key":"BASE64..."}'
```
Marie (Sales): Jordan — what language do we need for the SOW around key custody and rotation window? Customer expecting a 30-day rotation SLA with a 24h freeze window for cutover.
Jordan (Security Eng): SOW language suggestion (short): "Redwood will not retain unencrypted customer key material. Customer is responsible for key generation or providing wrapped key material. Redwood will perform import and coordinate rotation within the agreed maintenance window. Emergency rollback and audit artifacts will be provided per Section X." Need legal to sign off.
Priya (Acct Exec): I'll add the integration fee line and a configurable reserved-hours SKU. Also flag that multi-region HSM replication adds another cost band.
Customer IT: One last ask — can we run a canary production traffic slice to validate latency with your runtime while keys are in our HSM? Need a traffic window and limits.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Yes — we can run a 10% canary routed to your HSM-backed key path for 72 hours. We'll provide escalation contacts and SLIs.
presales-bot: Created checklist: https://internal.redwood/example-checklists/hsm-poc-check (ticket RW-4521). Added items: cert exchange, wrap format, export plan, SOW draft. :white_check_mark:
Marie (Sales): Great — I'll schedule a 30-min alignment tomorrow with customer + security + legal. @Jordan @Alex pls bring the SOW snippet + test commands. :thumbsup:
